disclosure_authority.authority_scope: Erin Spencer authorizes disclosure to the pinned evaluator of opaque commitments, source booking labels, and pre-response kappa trajectories only under the Cambridge-distributed CC-BY-4.0 source license; raw text, dialogue ids, response text, goals, metadata, ontology, databases, and later turns are prohibited

event_contract.admission: test-partition dialogue-act mapping contains exactly one of Booking-Book and Booking-NoBook and decimal source turn id maps to an in-range odd system response index
event_contract.kappa_production: speaker-prefix each preceding turn by even USER or odd SYSTEM; map each CR and LF to SPACE; parse_transcript(round_strategy=cycle) and compute_transcript with the clean pinned EDCM tree; prepend exact 0; encode every RoundMetrics.kappa as reduced Fraction(str(float_value))

decision_and_aggregation.admission: all 661 rows must have at least three ordered states, nonnegative reduced rational states, positive accumulated pressure, normalized score in [0,1], and score unequal to 3/5
decision_and_aggregation.falsified_if: all rows admit and any of sensitivity<1/2, specificity<1/2, or balanced_accuracy<=1/2
decision_and_aggregation.reporting: exact reduced rational estimates and integer confusion counts; no per-event outputs, fitted parameters, p-values, confidence intervals, calibration metrics, or alternate thresholds
decision_and_aggregation.survived_if: all rows admit and sensitivity>=1/2 and specificity>=1/2 and balanced_accuracy>1/2
decision_and_aggregation.unresolved_if: any admitted row has fewer than three states, zero accumulated positive pressure, or exact threshold equality

archive_after_two_runs: packet file SHA-256 and packet freeze commit
case payload subject digest without opening per-event rows
both UCNS external evaluation receipts and receipt ids
upstream completion receipt id and exact corpus manifest evidence identity
request_sha256, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256, byte counts, return code, timeout, and failure from each receipt
evaluator id, version, code reference, and executable SHA-256
aggregate response status, decision, admission counts, unresolved counts, confusion counts, sensitivity, specificity, and balanced accuracy when defined
attestation that caller-isolated network enforcement was active
attestation that no raw text, dialogue id, per-event label, trajectory, score, or external outcome was inspected before packet and case sealing
evidence_receipt_requirements.interpretation_gate: do not inspect aggregate outcome until two executions have complete receipts and equal request_sha256, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256, and response_results; elapsed seconds and receipt ids may differ

execution.argv: one absolute path resolving to the byte-identical pinned executable; no arguments
execution.network_requirement: deny all evaluator network access before launch; inability to enforce isolation is BLOCKED

failure_propagation.BLOCKED: archive, member, upstream receipt, source inventory, case digest, disclosure, executable digest, command, network enforcement, protocol, schema, resource, or reconciliation disagreement; evaluator exits nonzero or UCNS receipt is incomplete; do not score or substitute
failure_propagation.FALSIFIED: one complete deterministic aggregate response meets the falsified rule; scientific falsification is evidence and does not make transport incomplete
failure_propagation.SURVIVED: one complete deterministic aggregate response meets the survived rule; survival is candidate evidence only
failure_propagation.UNRESOLVED: structurally valid batch contains any mathematically undefined or threshold-tied row; one aggregate unresolved result, no row removal or denominator substitution

freeze.post_freeze_changes: any selectable evaluator, case, disclosure, metric, threshold, aggregation, limit, network, stop, propagation, or receipt change invalidates this packet before execution; after any label or outcome exposure a replacement case source is required

hmmm: This is a retrospective external-label replay on a public test partition used by the historical terminal-progress experiment, not a new independent hidden holdout.
The source booking acts are bounded action annotations, not independent adjudications of universal task success, user satisfaction, truth, intention, diagnosis, morality, or consciousness.
Accumulated positive kappa pressure and temporal sampling comparability remain unvalidated real-system semantics.
A complete transport receipt cannot establish measurement validity, empirical validity, selection, activation, canon, or proof status.

plan.question: On the frozen MultiWOZ 2.1 test booking-event batch, does normalized recovered dissonance per accumulated positive pressure at the control-only threshold 3/5 discriminate Booking-Book from Booking-NoBook under the preregistered aggregate rule?

stopping_rules: generate and seal exactly one canonical 661-record batch after packet freeze without displaying its rows
execute exactly twice with the same upstream receipt, case payload, executable, argv, environment, limits, and network isolation
stop BLOCKED on any structural or transport failure; do not retry with changed settings
stop UNRESOLVED on any admitted undefined or tied row; do not exclude, impute, or replace it
after equal deterministic evidence receipts, record exactly one SURVIVED or FALSIFIED aggregate outcome
do not search features, normalizers, thresholds, partitions, exclusions, metrics, aggregations, evaluators, limits, or stopping rules
do not inspect per-event rows or promote measurement validity, activation, selection, canon, proof, or theorem status

required_manifest_evidence_identity: aggregate-only; raw dialogue text remains in caller-held source custody and outside Git
none-preserve-source; no transformed or redacted substitute is used for exact execution
